The registered contract requires increasing successive values; equal and decreasing transitions count against it. Its15 transitions in11 paragraphs contain10 equal,2 decreasing and3 increasing, so that unchanged simple counter is rejected. This does not reject general quantities, ordinal references, repeated item identifiers, independently motivated resets or current-carry meanings.
